No clinical data validation experience - no study design, no reader/clinician ground truth, no sensitivity/specificity reporting against a clinical reference standard

TensorFlow - appears in the skills list and TFLite export, but every substantive model in the profile is PyTorch

screening_gaps: Zero medical device / FDA-regulated algorithm experience - Eko has 8+ FDA clearances and a screener for the Algorithm team will look for design-control and submission exposure first
Zero physiological biosignal work - no ECG or heart/lung sound algorithms anywhere in the profile, which is the specific domain the team hires into
No signal-processing algorithm deployed and maintained in a real production system, which the JD names explicitly as a key requirement
llm_analysis.reasoning: The Algorithm Engineer track is the only one of the four Eko lists that he can credibly enter, and against it the tooling stack (Python, NumPy, PyTorch, TF, quantization, edge deployment) and the from-scratch audio pipeline are strong, defensible evidence. What is absent is the domain itself: no biosignals, no FDA design controls, no production-owned algorithm. This is a general-interest resume pool rather than a live opening, so it is cheap to enter and worth doing, but it should be treated as a low-probability, long-horizon submission backed by outreach rather than a targeted application.
